sentences.text: The Marbled White has been reported in Mainz-Bingen mainly in June and July.
It is recorded as a pollinator of Carthusian Pink, Small Scabious, and field scabious.
It is also recorded as a pollinator of zigzag clover, Red Clover, Betony, and Oxeye Daisy.
It has additionally been recorded visiting the flowers of field scabious.
